text.p: These are the main headlines reported reported by Radio Latvia on Thursday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- Russian ambassador Aleksandr Udaltsov says border talks will not be called off despite of Russia's view on human rights in Latvia. The talks will take place next week and will be succesful, Udaltsov said.
- Russia will not recognise the alien's passports issued by Latvia.
- A U.S. State department delegation arrived in Riga to meet defence and foreign ministry officials and to discuss NATO enlargement.
- The third largest government faction For Fatherland and Freedom submitted amendments to the law on elections.
- The parliamentary commissions to investigate the G-24 credits and the Unibanka and Savings Bank (Krajbanka) privatisations were named today.
